text: also: there is no undo/redo history on this rig movement and such
resolution: Implemented resident native Character Rig undo/redo and routed the editor's single Undo/Redo authority to it only while the exact active rig session owns viewport input. Durable fit, joint transform/constraint/lock, object-binding, and auto-bind edits restore bones, fit metadata, descriptor state, f32 weight buffers, binding hashes, saved-binding/error/review state; view/selection/overlay/test-pose changes do not journal. Added explicit Rig controls and truthful dock/menu/hotkey depths, stale-session and mesh-mode fallback guards, redo-branch/no-op/rejected-command behavior, and dirty-state propagation after restore. Focused TS suites pass (22 command, 4 ownership, 8 session-door, 5 panel tests), native test-character-rig-session passes 11/11, tools/tsc-check editor passes, and SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor succeeds in ReleaseFast. Scope is honestly resident-session history; cold cross-session total history needs the separate active V20 persistence substrate and is not claimed here.
